## Goal
Require a validated complete TaskCollection before approval sync enters its append-only flow-state mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- R7 preserves existing-task filtering, round assignment, parent/status/origin fields, task steps, and pending promotion.
- Generated flow task paths use only validated TaskId values.

## Implementation Notes
Construct TaskCollection immediately after loading spec.json and before calculating or mutating new flow tasks. Build appended task records from validated task views while leaving existing flow tasks untouched.

## Test Strategy
